reason: Most of my covers are tourists who come once. They judge me on Google and Tripadvisor, not on some new local app, so dish ratings that stay inside HoReCa Hub and a loyalty reward for people who never come back don't do much for me. My regulars already know me.
objection: The reviews that matter to me go to Google and Tripadvisor. If those verified ratings don't push guests there, I'm paying 59 a month plus an extra card fee on every bill to build a review pile nobody I care about reads, and I already pay the terminal fees.
would_change_my_mind: If after paying, the guest is prompted to leave a Google or Tripadvisor review, and splitting the bill by phone actually turns tables faster for big tourist groups, with a per-transaction fee no higher than my current terminal.
